name: Appendectomy
summary: How expats handle suspected appendicitis and appendectomy pathways in Singapore — A&E timing, laparoscopic norms, and what to tell insurers and employers after an unplanned admission.
body:
Appendicitis is a classic middle-of-the-night A&E story for newcomers who still Googled “food poisoning.” Migrating right-lower pain, fever, and rebound tenderness need urgent evaluation — not a next-week GP slot.

## Pathway
- A&E triage, bloods, imaging (US/CT as indicated)
- Surgical review for laparoscopic appendectomy in most uncomplicated cases
- Antibiotics and observation only in selected protocols
- Histology follow-up and wound care after discharge
- Unplanned leave letters for HR/schools

Tourists and short-visit parents use the same emergency doors; payment deposits differ by pass/insurance.

## Aftercare
Watch fever, wound redness, and diarrhoea after antibiotics. Ask about return-to-exercise and when swimming pools are allowed in this climate. Keep discharge summaries for insurance claims.

## How to choose
In emergencies you rarely “shop” surgeons — focus on hospital capability and your coverage. For interval appendectomy after drained abscess, seek clear timing plans before overseas leave.

## Practical tip
Save your insurer’s emergency hotline in your phone before you need it. Photograph the discharge summary — paper fades in humid bags.
